name: Canvas Grid
description: Grid pattern generator and CSS applicator for the infinite canvas. Generates dots (2px circle at origin, 65% alpha) or grid (bottom-right L-shaped lines, 30% alpha) patterns as data URLs using an offscreen HTML Canvas. Applies pattern as CSS background-image with repeat, scaled size, and panned position. Resolves grid color from --tertiary CSS custom property.

functions.name: generateGridPattern
functions.description: Returns data URL for dots or grid pattern, empty string for 'none'

functions.name: applyGridToElement
functions.signature: (el: HTMLElement, style: GridStyle, dataURL: string, patternSize: number, scale: number, panX: number, panY: number) => void
functions.description: Sets background-image, size, repeat, and position on element
